verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents ZeroTrace Mode, a user-enabled setting under which search parameters, files, and data are not stored, so users get a real retention opt-out. Otherwise the only retention behaviour documented is the default 1-hour result cache and a Searches Archive API that implies results are stored. missing for 10: configurable retention periods, an explicit way to delete stored searches or archive data, documentation of which plans include ZeroTrace and how to enable it, independent or hands-on corroboration.
